Human-in-the-loop by construction: no agent sends mail, enters passwords or submits forms.

known_gaps.title: No formal software-engineering background
known_gaps.detail: No CS degree and no production engineering employment. Builds with AI agents under tests and review; the codebases are evidence, not a job title.
known_gaps.mitigation: Ships tested code with AI agents under review: 288 tests in the trading engine, 108 in the analytics engine. The role asks for exactly this way of building.

state.operating_assumption: He joins LEVA as Product Architect reporting to the CTO. LEVA's senior legal counsel and compliance analyst own legal and regulatory interpretation; a Financial Systems Engineer, a Lead Architect and full-stack engineers build with him. He prototypes with AI coding agents, as in his own builds, and has the usual onboarding time to learn LEVA's partnership structure and product.
build_speed: This portal: first commit to live, access-controlled AI service in 31 minutes; page, proxy and 15 automated tests in 41 minutes (git timestamps, 20 Oct 2026).
Risk-governed trading engine: 83 commits, ~35,000 lines and 288 tests in under four weeks (Aug-Sep 2026).
AI CV-review tool: idea to a live, calibrated tool on GitHub Pages in about 3.5 months part-time, alongside an EMBA (2026).
PrevioRisk (2013, before AI tools): a full counterparty-risk product to market in 7 months against an 11-month plan, with 15 developers.

time_to_prototype.instructions: How long would `candidate` need to build a clickable prototype of `project.title` on test data, good enough to demo to LEVA's deal managers or compliance team? A prototype needs no production integration, no compliance sign-off and no real customer data. Judge from `build_speed` (his measured pace with AI coding agents), `project.brief`, `project.characteristics`, `evidence`, and `known_gaps` with their `mitigation`.

mvp_success.instructions: With the support described in `operating_assumption`, will `candidate` lead `project.title` to a usable MVP that LEVA's customers or compliance team use within three months, rather than it stalling in specification? Judge from `build_speed`, `evidence`, `known_gaps` with their `mitigation`, `project.characteristics` and `operating_assumption`.

evidence_fit.instructions: How closely does the `evidence` match what `project.title` (`project.brief`) actually requires?
criteria: partial: some core parts done before
strong: most core parts done before
direct: has delivered an equivalent product

needs_specialist.instructions: Will `project.title` need outside specialist expertise (legal, tax, licensing or crypto-asset) that neither `candidate` nor LEVA's own legal counsel and compliance analyst can provide, rather than knowledge available inside the team or learnable on the job?

main_risk.instructions: What is the single biggest risk to `candidate` delivering `project.title`, given `evidence`, `known_gaps` and `project.characteristics`?

criteria.domain: missing domain knowledge (private markets, crypto assets, KYC/AML)
criteria.regulatory: waiting on a regulator, auditor or licence approval
criteria.stakeholders: aligning legal, compliance, customers and engineering
criteria.scope: unclear scope or a changing vision
